about: Class types and their blocks. Only Flow is switched on. Block order never changes. Block minutes come from timing templates and must add up to the class length.

classTypes.label: Flow
classTypes.description: Ten blocks, same order every time. The exercises change.

peakBlock.note: The peak pose goes near the end of full body integration.

blocks.label: Footwork
blocks.purpose: Warm up legs and feet. Reformer or chair. Heels, arches, toes, close or wide, parallel or turned out, full range, halfway, pulses.

blocks.label: Bridging
blocks.purpose: Hinge or articulated bridges. Flows straight on from reformer footwork.

blocks.label: Abs
blocks.purpose: Abdominal work. Spring drop for strap abs is fine.

blocks.label: Upper body
blocks.purpose: Arms, shoulders, upper back. Plenty of options beyond straps.

blocks.label: Side and lateral work
blocks.purpose: Side bending, side-lying and outer hip work. Added block, Jay to confirm.

blocks.label: Full body integration
blocks.purpose: Whole body work. The peak pose lands here, near the end.

blocks.label: Prone work for the spine
blocks.purpose: Lying face down or kneeling back extension.

blocks.label: Stretch
blocks.purpose: Release what was worked. Added block, Jay to confirm.

blocks.label: Closing pull down and wind down
blocks.purpose: Finish standing or seated, calm and tall.

timingTemplates.name: Standard
timingTemplates.note: Footwork, bridging and abs minutes from Jay. The rest split evenly to total 50.

timingTemplates.name: Gentle pace (older clients)
timingTemplates.note: Longer warm-up and wind-down for older clients, as Jay asked.

timingTemplates.name: Long warm-up
timingTemplates.note: Jay's example of a 15 minute warm-up.

scoring.about: Soft rule weights. Higher means the generator cares more. All are assumptions to tune with Jay. Equipment change cost is multiplied by the client group's pace factor, so older classes change equipment less.

minMinutes.note: Smallest a block can be on the timing screen.

maxMinutes.note: Largest a block can be on the timing screen.
